question: What is the average order value (revenue per delivered order)?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS order_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT AVG(order_revenue) AS average_order_value
FROM delivered
plan: • Identify delivered orders where orders.order_status = 'delivered'. • Join orders to order_items on order_id to get price and freight_value for each item. • Compute revenue per order by summing price + freight_value across its items. • Aggregate across all delivered orders to calculate the average of these order revenues. • No additional filters needed beyond delivered status. • Return a single numeric value representing the average order value.
